title: Filenode -16 -> -19: breaking wire/API changes
description: Before 0.5.0. Posted draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-19 (https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-19.txt) vs crates' -16 baseline. (1) §3.2.3 remove onExists newest/unchanged: client FileNodeOnExists::{Newest,Unchanged} (client/src/methods/filenode.rs:94,101), server parser (server/filenode.rs:457, :562). (2) §2.1 remove forbiddenNodeNames: types/src/capability.rs:57 pub field + wire key. (3) §3.2.5 query depth counts from top level; absent/null = no limit (server/filenode.rs:2533 defaults 0); §3.2.6 queryChanges takes depth. (4) §3.1.2/§5 myRights, shareWith, isSubscribed only on nodes that permit children; Files take parent's rights (get handler server/filenode.rs:299). Check whether FileNodeBackend::files_rights (server/backend.rs:654) must change for inheritance (breaking trait change -> do it now). (5) cheap: §3.2.5 text filter substring not glob (memory.rs:1592,1839). Update -16 citations (server/lib.rs:1, README). Gap analysis: scratchpad drafts fn-16.txt/fn-19.txt; sized ~0.5 day. Fix filenode first, then chat-filenode (t8ej.28).
